children: The proposed entity will build and own digital infrastructure, pursue telecom licences and provide connectivity services to hyperscalers, data centre operators and enterprises

STL Networks, the digital infrastructure services company operating under the Invenia brand, has approved the incorporation of STL Networks DC. The proposed subsidiary will focus on building and owning digital infrastructure and providing connectivity services for data centre customers.

The subsidiary will have an initial paid-up capital of Rs 1 lakh, comprising 50,000 equity shares with a face value of Rs 2 each. STL Networks will subscribe to the entire share capital in cash, making the proposed entity a wholly owned subsidiary.

The proposed company will undertake activities related to establishing, acquiring, owning, operating and managing data centre and telecommunications infrastructure. It will also seek relevant telecom licences and regulatory approvals required to provide connectivity services.

The subsidiary is expected to serve hyperscalers, data centre operators and enterprises. The move will allow STL Networks to develop a dedicated platform for data centre connectivity and expand its involvement across the infrastructure and connectivity lifecycle.
The company said the initiative is part of its broader strategy to participate in the AI data centre ecosystem and address demand for connectivity-led infrastructure services.

Chandrasekhara Rao Battula, Whole Time Director and Interim CEO, Invenia-STL Networks, said the company’s expansion into connectivity builds on its existing digital infrastructure capabilities and is intended to help data centre operators, hyperscalers and enterprises meet their growing infrastructure requirements.
The company has not disclosed the proposed subsidiary’s total investment, operational launch timeline, expected revenue or specific customer contracts as part of the announcement.
